verdict.rationale: Gitea ships an official CLI ('tea') documented at gitea.com/gitea/tea, covering repo/issue/PR management from the command line. However, evidence doesn't explicitly frame it as 'AI-native' or show agentic/scripting-friendly design beyond the existence of the tool. Missing for 10: detailed docs on tea's command surface for automation/agent use, independent hands-on validation, and explicit AI-native positioning.
